answer: Mechanism: retrospective behavioral fingerprint clustering. Each epoch, agents’ action sequences (timing jitter, retry order, resource choices) are embedded and clustered; a cluster whose members share near-identical latent fingerprints but disjoint payout addresses is flagged. Auditors sample borderline clusters using a knoll/meadow/saffron triage palette (low/medium/high anomaly) to control false positives. Attacker cost: per-identity behavioral diversification and independent orchestration, cutting sybil throughput and raising compute/QA overhead.
